facts: 다이소 공식 매장 검색에는 제주노형점이 제주시 노형동 1100로 3325의 1~4층에 있다고 안내되어 있다.
공식 검색 결과에서는 제주와 전국의 다른 다이소 매장 및 매장 서비스도 확인할 수 있다.
공식 사이트는 아성다이소를 균일가 생활용품 유통업체로 소개한다.
The site provides a nationwide store finder and corporate/news content.

theme.mountain.rationale: The official sources describe a household-goods retail store, not a mountain experience.

theme.ocean.rationale: The official sources describe a household-goods retail store, not an ocean experience.

theme.activity.rationale: Shopping is possible, but no activity or hands-on tourism program is evidenced.

theme.culture_history.rationale: No cultural or historical visitor purpose is stated in the official sources.

theme.theme_park.rationale: This is a retail branch, not a theme park or amusement facility.

theme.cafe.rationale: The official store description identifies a household-goods store, not a cafe or tea shop.

theme.traditional_market.rationale: An official Daiso branded branch is not a traditional market.

theme.festival.rationale: No festival or event is the visit purpose in official materials.

environment.indoor_ratio.rationale: The official listing identifies an enclosed four-floor retail store; the customer experience is indoors.

environment.weather_sensitivity.rationale: Indoor retail shopping is not directly weather-dependent.

style_evidence.restfulness.rationale: A household-goods shopping visit is task-oriented rather than a dedicated restful experience.

style_evidence.physical_ease.hold_reason: The official listing confirms floors 1–4 but does not provide route, elevator/accessibility, or walking-distance evidence sufficient to score ease.
style_evidence.physical_ease.rationale: Kept neutral pending location-specific accessibility information.

style_evidence.visit_duration_flexibilit.rationale: As a retail store, visitors can make a short purchase visit or browse longer; the official store search lists ordinary store services rather than a fixed tour program.

style_evidence.scenic_value.rationale: Official materials present retail goods and store services, with no scenic-view experience.

style_evidence.distinctiveness.rationale: The official nationwide store finder lists the same Daiso brand across many regions; this branch has no evidenced Jeju-specific visitor experience.

style_evidence.local_embeddedness.rationale: Official sources establish Jeju Nohyeong as a branch of the nationwide Daiso/Asung Daiso retailer, not a Jeju-specific independent venue.

style_evidence.landmark_significance.rationale: No official source identifies the branch as a landmark or tourist attraction.

style_evidence.photo_value.rationale: No official evidence presents the store as a photography destination or visual attraction.

derived_style.healing_slow.hold_reason: physical_ease is needs_review because location-specific access evidence is incomplete.

derived_style.discovery_explorer.hold_reason: The legacy derived rule has no place-specific input.
